evidence_tier_summary.policy: Only evidence_cards are parsed into the relation graph. Metadata-only records participate in bibliographic retrieval but cannot support graph relations.

search_audit.inclusion: OpenAlex type:article; DOI and venue present; publication date 2015-2026; venue ISSN in curated top-journal list; title/abstract passes weighted domain keyword threshold.
search_audit.exclusion: Corrections, errata, retractions, editorials, supplements; missing DOI/venue/date; duplicate DOI; off-topic records.
search_audit.selection: Top-journal ISSN filter; multi-query merge with DOI dedup; citation-count descending; weighted keyword relevance; top 100 selected.
